title: Design System: HAU-USC Logistics Management System

source.note: Refreshed by R3-A1-A2 from the current shipped design authority. Adds the semantic status roles (destructive, green-open) and the shared account-panel input surface, which ship in theme.css but were previously undeclared, so the detector read real system tokens as drift (FE-R3-013).

oxblood-deep.purpose: The institutional anchor. Public navbar, footer, dark-mode ground, primary-button ink.

oxblood-mid.purpose: Secondary oxblood structure and borders on dark fields.

gold-canonical.purpose: OWNER-LOCKED per DESIGN.md D08.0. Not derived, not negotiable. Marks active controls, focus and selection — never routine labels.

gold-dark-mode.purpose: Dark mode lifts the canonical gold toward paper because #D4AF37 sits too close to the dark surfaces to carry a decisive accent. Same hue, more light.

accent-text.purpose: Gold-family text on light working surfaces. Measures 5.46:1 on the composited G2 pane. gold/400 measured 1.52:1 and failed AA, which is why this token exists.

paper-warm.purpose: The working surface. Public and authentication surfaces sit here.

ink-deep.purpose: Primary reading ink. Oxblood-charcoal rather than #000 — at L* 16 on an L* 95.4 plane it measures 13:1, and going blacker buys only glare.

border-warm.purpose: Gold-family control borders. WCAG 2.2 1.4.11 requires 3:1 for anything identifying a control, measured against every surface it can sit on.

border-paper.purpose: Quiet structural separation on paper surfaces.

surfaceLadder.note: Declared as INTENT — a target CIE L*, chroma and hue — not as hex. Hex is the output. One step up the ladder means the same perceived distance in light and dark.

light.chromaDirection: decreases up the ladder, so the cream lives in the environment and the reading plane stays near-neutral

steps.name: ground
steps.purpose: environmental canvas; never carries reading content

steps.name: inset
steps.purpose: recess inside the work plane: filter bars, table headers, disabled regions

steps.name: work
steps.purpose: primary reading and operational plane; tables, forms, records

dark.chromaDirection: increases up the ladder, so rising out of the ground reads as moving toward the institution rather than toward grey
dark.note: Nothing approaches #000: the darkest surface is L* 8.6, which keeps large dark fields legible instead of crushed.

display.purpose: Display face. Section and hero headings that carry institutional weight.

editorial.purpose: Editorial hero face and institutional wordmarks. Used where the product speaks as the University Student Council.

body.purpose: Operational copy, controls and labels. The face an operator reads for a whole shift.

mono.purpose: Reference codes, tracking codes, eyebrow labels and any value that must be transcribed exactly.

shadows.name: glass-shadow-soft-light
shadows.purpose: Institutional Glass, resting elevation on light surfaces.

shadows.name: glass-shadow-raised-light
shadows.purpose: Institutional Glass, raised elevation on light surfaces.

shadows.name: glass-shadow-soft-dark
shadows.purpose: Institutional Glass, resting elevation on dark surfaces.

shadows.name: glass-shadow-raised-dark
shadows.purpose: Institutional Glass, raised elevation on dark surfaces.

glass.note: Institutional Glass is localised to layers that earn it, never a wash over the whole application. Second generation: fill up, blur down at every step.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for entrances and anything arriving.

motion.name: dur-response
motion.purpose: Direct manipulation feedback: press, hover, focus.

motion.name: dur-narrative
motion.purpose: Staggered entrance choreography on the public landing only.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The single primary action on a public surface. Gold field, oxblood ink. Used for 'Start a logistics request'.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary" type="button" aria-label="Start a logistics request in the public Request Center. No sign-in needed.">Start a logistics request</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 48px; border-radius: 0.625rem; padding-inline: 1.25rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; white-space: nowrap; color: #40070a; background: #e8b93c; border: 1px solid #d1b478; transition: transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), opacity 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); opacity: 0.75; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e8b93c; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Action (Glass)
components.description: Companion action on the public hero. Institutional Glass rather than a second gold field, so gold stays scarce.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 48px; border-radius: 0.625rem; padding-inline: 1.25rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; color: #faeecb; background: rgba(120,20,26,0.55); backdrop-filter: blur(10px) saturate(112%); border: 1px solid rgba(242,209,92,0.28); box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.26); transition: transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(141,31,40,0.62); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e8b93c; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Action
components.description: Quiet tertiary path. 'Track request' and 'Staff sign in' sit here so neither competes with public intake.
components.css: .ds-btn-text { min-height: 44px; padding-inline: 0.5rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; color: #faeecb; background: none; border: none; border-radius: 0.625rem; text-underline-offset: 4px; transition: opacity 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-text:hover { text-decoration: underline; opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-text:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e8b93c; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Public Access Banner
components.description: States the public no-login contract at the top of the Request and Lending centres. This is product truth, not decoration: the public service never places authentication in front of intake.
components.html:
No account and no sign-in needed

Open to USC staff and officers, and to every Angelite student. You do not need a HAU-USC Logistics account, staff sign-in, activation, or approval to submit.
components.css: .ds-access { border-radius: 0.625rem; padding: 16px 20px; background: rgba(120,20,26,0.42); border: 1px solid rgba(242,209,92,0.28); backdrop-filter: blur(10px) saturate(112%); } .ds-access__title { margin: 0 0 4px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; color: #faeecb; } .ds-access__body { margin: 0; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; line-height: 1.5; color: #f6e29a; }

components.name: Eyebrow Label
components.description: Mono, uppercase, letterspaced. Names the context of a surface — 'PUBLIC REQUEST · NO SIGN-IN'. Never decorative.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { margin: 0; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.625rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #f2d15c; }

components.name: Public Navbar
components.description: Sticky public header on oxblood glass. Carries the USC and Department of Logistics lockups and a separate, visually quiet Staff sign in.
components.html: University Student Council
components.css: .ds-nav { position: sticky; top: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 20px; padding: 14px 20px; background: rgba(64,7,10,0.82); backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(118%); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(242,209,92,0.16); } .ds-nav__brand { font-family: 'Newsreader', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; color: #fff; letter-spacing: -0.075px; } .ds-nav__signin { margin-left: auto; min-height: 32px; padding-inline: 13px; border-radius: 0.625rem; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: #faeecb; background: none; border: 1px solid #d1b478; } .ds-nav__signin:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e8b93c; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Operational Field
components.description: Text input on the warm-paper working plane. Border meets 1.4.11 against ground, inset and work surfaces.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-field__label { font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; color: #241416; } .ds-field__input { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 0.5rem; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #241416; background: #fffdf8; border: 1px solid #d1b478; } .ds-field__input::placeholder { color: #6f5a60; } .ds-field__input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7d5518; outline-offset: 1px; border-color: #7d5518; }

components.name: Status Tone
components.description: Communicates lifecycle state. Status is never carried by colour alone — the label always states the state in words.
components.css: .ds-tone { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 999px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; font-style: normal; letter-spacing: 0.02em; } .ds-tone--info { background: #e4eefa; color: #23557f; border: 1px solid #b0cbe6; } .ds-tone--done { background: #e2f3e9; color: #1f6b41; border: 1px solid #a8d3ba; } .ds-tone--warn { background: #fbe6e8; color: #9c2630; border: 1px solid #e3aeb3; }

narrative.overview:
HAU-USC Logistics is a governed operational record, not a dashboard in university colours. Actions have owners, states, timestamps and consequences, and the interface is built so that each of those is visible rather than implied.

Oxblood is the institutional anchor and carries structure: the public navbar, the footer, the dark-mode ground. Gold is scarce and deliberate — it marks active controls, focus and selection, never routine labels. Warm paper is the working surface where an operator spends a shift. Institutional Glass is localised to layers that earn it, never a wash over the whole application.

The system has two contexts sharing one record. The public service — Request Center, Lending Center, tracking — never places authentication, activation or approval in front of intake, browsing or tracking. Staff operations sit behind a separate sign-in and are capability-gated. A staff sign-in link is not a staff sign-in requirement, and the two must never be visually conflated.
keyCharacteristics: Oxblood structure, disciplined gold, warm paper working surface
Institutional Glass is contextual and localised, never ambient
Lines are semantic; decorative rules are rejected
Purposeful asymmetry and operational hierarchy over centred symmetry
Module intensity is tuned to the job: Overview 5/5, public gateway 4/5, Inventory/Request/Lending 3/5, Release Desk 2/5, Staff and Administration 1/5
Colour is carried by variables; the design file holds zero paint styles

rules.name: Gold is scarce
rules.body: Gold marks active controls, focus and selection. It does not mark routine labels, and a surface with two competing gold fields has already failed. The canonical primary gold is #D4AF37 and is OWNER-LOCKED — it is not derived and not negotiable.

rules.name: Accent text is not accent fill
rules.body: Gold-family text on light working surfaces uses accent-text #7d5518, which measures 5.46:1. Using the canonical gold as text on paper measures 1.52:1 and fails WCAG 2.2 AA 1.4.3. The two tokens are not interchangeable.

rules.name: Nothing reaches pure black or pure white
rules.body: Light ink is oxblood-charcoal at L* 16, not #000; dark ink is a warm off-white at L* 93, not #FFF. The darkest dark surface is L* 8.6. Both directions buy legibility, and going further buys only glare or crush.

rules.name: Glass must earn its layer
rules.body: Institutional Glass applies to layers that genuinely float: the sticky public navbar, hero companion actions, overlays. Fill goes up as blur comes down at each step. Glass as a full-page wash is an anti-pattern here.

rules.name: Status is never colour alone
rules.body: Every status tone states the state in words. Colour reinforces; it never carries the meaning.

rules.name: The public service is never gated
rules.body: Public intake, browsing and tracking never require or probe a session. Every public 'Start a logistics request' control navigates to the public Request Center and must not call requireAuth.

dos: Do bind colour to variables rather than declaring hex in components
Do keep gold for active state, focus and selection
Do state the public no-sign-in contract in words on public surfaces
Do position surfaces on the L* ladder rather than picking a hex by eye
Do give every control a visible focus ring and a 44px minimum touch target
Do honour prefers-reduced-motion; the entrance choreography is enhancement, not structure
donts: Don't use the canonical gold #D4AF37 as text on warm paper — it fails AA at 1.52:1
Don't wash a whole surface in glass
Don't add decorative rules or dividers that do not connect, divide or select
Don't put a staff sign-in, activation or approval step in front of public intake
Don't communicate a lifecycle state by colour alone
Don't converge on a generic SaaS dashboard; purposeful asymmetry and operational hierarchy are the identity
